game.desc: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings is a role-playing game for Xbox 360. It once again features Geralt de Riv, who must deal with conspiracies to eliminate all the crowned heads. Evolve in a dark world by customising your character freely, influencing the story through dialogue, and using devastating combos.
